description: This file contains row level security policies and related SQL commands for managing access control in a Learning Management System (LMS) backend built with PostgreSQL and Supabase. It defines policies for tables such as profiles, lessons, quizzes, assignments, and quiz_submissions to enforce role-based access control.
calls: alter table public.profiles enable row level security
alter table public.lessons enable row level security
alter table public.quizzes enable row level security
alter table public.assignments enable row level security
alter table public.quiz_submissions enable row level security
